elaine cho: Quick heads-up: planning a fallback reorder for `orca-11b-v3` in Tuesday's change window (2026-05-12 01:00-01:40 UTC).
elain e cho: Aim: prefer quant-4bit for batch-heavy routes to cut memory, no weights change, just catalog ordering + pool scoping.
omar reyes: What's the rollout plan? regional or global?
elaine cho: Regional: NA canary 2% for 10m, EU delayed 20m, APAC hold. enterprise pools pinned by default.
nina product: QA wants rollback triggers: error rate +1% abs over 5m OR p95 >1.7x baseline for 10m OR quality eval drop >3% on 12 prompts.
deploybot: DeployBot: catalog-change request received for `orca-11b-v3`. Preflight: canary 2% (10m), telemetry checks, quality eval (12 prompts). Reply `@deploybot approve` to proceed.
omar reyes: Approving infra side; I'll monitor node evictions and pool pressure.
elaine cho: Adding `pool_scope: ['shared']` and `enterprise_pinlist: [acct-221,acct-333]`. Will attach eval prompts to ticket.
nina product: I'll be on watch for QA manual-review during canary.
elaine cho: Thanks all — will kick off at the window and post results here. :white_check_mark:
